basics.name: Daniel Yamin
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience in software development and algorithms. Strong background in computational neuroscience and data science. Career spans startups to global corporations, with expertise in building scalable backend systems.

work.name: Chaos Labs
work.summary: Design and maintain highly scalable backend systems for real-time DeFi risk platforms. Integrate data pipelines into decentralized systems. Optimize infrastructure for low-latency and high availability.

work.name: Tel-Aviv University & Sipple
work.summary: Led research on eye movement analysis using advanced signal processing and ML. Published research paper on novel no-report paradigm for memory studies. Developed data science pipeline for sound events detection.

work.name: Microsoft
work.summary: Azure Defender for IoT team. Built advanced security solutions for IoT & OT devices at global scale. Developed Vulnerability Assessment system for matching CVEs to IoT devices. Implemented detection algorithms for security alerts.

work.name: Allot
work.summary: Developed DDoS Secure, a real-time network behavior anomaly detection system. Refactored backend from Ruby to Java and redesigned database architecture. Built REST API for BIRD routing demon using BGP protocol.

work.name: Didact
work.summary: Developed online adaptive marketplace for video lessons. Accepted into MindCet accelerator.

awards.title: RoboCup International Representative
awards.summary: Led team to national victory and represented Israel in international RoboCup competition in Atlanta, Georgia.

awards.title: Young Researchers Program
awards.summary: Participated in Chetz project - advanced research program during high school.

projects.name: MEGA - Memory Episode Gaze Anticipation
projects.summary: Research project introducing a novel methodology using eye-tracking technology to measure memory retrieval without verbal responses. Analyzes anticipatory gaze patterns to index episodic memory traces.
